description: Historical one-shot workflow sources retained as nonexecuting documentation; core P3 adapter in main.

files.source:
name: S2B original same-input fully native P1-P2-P3 scientific probe
on:
  push:
    branches: [automation/verify-s2b-full-native-20261017]
    paths: [.github/workflows/s2b-full-native-handoff-science-20261017.yml]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  native-p123-original-comparison:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify pinned native source only
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "b7245363108ee280f32decd0fde00e49f0b67da1"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/s2b-full-native-handoff-science-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach "b7245363108ee280f32decd0fde00e49f0b67da1"
          echo "S2B_FULL_NATIVE_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Restore only authorized public frozen SRTM crop to ephemeral runner
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/s2b-real-p123
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 --output /tmp/s2b-real-p123/srtm-hefei.tif https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RRain001/CTEAS/dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13/calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.tif
          echo 'c4211914fce527d2ad41ecac1e668d7faa2904bbbfd9135868ee83ef0d32123f  /tmp/s2b-real-p123/srtm-hefei.tif' | sha256sum --check
          test "$(stat -c %s /tmp/s2b-real-p123/srtm-hefei.tif)" = 14648
          echo 'S2B_SRTM_RESTORE=SHA_VERIFIED_EPHEMERAL_PRIVATE_SCRATCH_ONLY'
      - name: Compile native P1, P2, P3 and original-compatible input writers
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgdal-dev
          cmake -S native_cpp/p1 -B /tmp/s2b-p1 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/s2b-p1 --target cteas_p1_terrain --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp -B /tmp/s2b-p2 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/s2b-p2 --target cteas_p2_gen_fraction --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp/p3 -B /tmp/s2b-p3 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/s2b-p3 --parallel 2
          ctest --test-dir /tmp/s2b-p3 --output-on-failure
      - name: Execute actual native P1 and P2 on identical original scientific source inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /tmp/s2b-p1/cteas_p1_terrain /tmp/s2b-real-p123/srtm-hefei.tif 510.8846439571007 3531.2689269678035 /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p1.csv
          /tmp/s2b-p2/cteas_p2_gen_fraction calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt 510.8846439571007 3531.2689269678035 /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p2.csv
          /tmp/s2b-p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat terrain /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p1.csv /tmp/s2b-real-p123/terrel.dat
          /tmp/s2b-p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat landuse /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p2.csv /tmp/s2b-real-p123/lu.dat
      - name: Independently compare all newly native source fields with frozen original P1/P2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv,json,hashlib
          root=Path('/tmp/s2b-real-p123')
          original=Path('project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011')
          a=[float(v) for line in (original/'geo/terrel/terrel.dat').read_text().splitlines()[10:] for v in line.split()]
          b=[float(v) for line in (root/'terrel.dat').read_text().splitlines()[10:] for v in line.split()]
          if len(a)!=2500 or len(b)!=2500: raise SystemExit('Unexpected terrain record count')
          p1err=[(n%50+1,n//50+1,x,y) for n,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)) if x!=y]
          terrain_src=[dict(row) for row in csv.DictReader((root/'p1.csv').open())]
          if len(terrain_src)!=2500: raise SystemExit('Native P1 CSV incomplete')
          unrounded=[abs(float(row['elevation_m'])-a[(49-int(row['j']))*50+(int(row['i'])-1)]) for row in terrain_src]
          lu_old=(original/'geo/ctgproc/lu.dat').read_text().splitlines()
          lu_new=(root/'lu.dat').read_text().splitlines()
          if len(lu_old)!=2511 or len(lu_new)!=2511: raise SystemExit('LU record count mismatch')
          fraction_mismatch=[]
          for n,(o,g) in enumerate(zip(lu_old[11:],lu_new[11:])):
            x,y=o.split(),g.split()
            if len(x)!=41 or len(y)!=41 or x[:2]!=y[:2] or x[-1]!=y[-1]: raise SystemExit('Bad LU data record')
            for k,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x[2:-1],y[2:-1])):
              if float(u)!=float(v) and len(fraction_mismatch)<50: fraction_mismatch.append((n,k,float(u),float(v)))
          allbad=sum(sum(float(u)!=float(v) for u,v in zip(o.split()[2:-1],g.split()[2:-1])) for o,g in zip(lu_old[11:],lu_new[11:]))
          out={'run_scope':'actual native P1 SRTM and native P2 GENERIC, original frozen reference',
               'terrain_cells':2500,'terrain_displayed_mismatches':len(p1err),'terrain_first_30':p1err[:30],
               'unrounded_terrain_max_abs_error_m':max(unrounded),
               'landuse_fraction_fields':95000,'landuse_displayed_mismatches':allbad,
               'landuse_first_50':fraction_mismatch,
               'source_tif_sha256':'c4211914fce527d2ad41ecac1e668d7faa2904bbbfd9135868ee83ef0d32123f',
               'source_native_sha':'b7245363108ee280f32decd0fde00e49f0b67da1',
               'reference_terrain_sha256':hashlib.sha256((original/'geo/terrel/terrel.dat').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               'native_terrain_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'terrel.dat').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               'reference_lu_sha256':hashlib.sha256((original/'geo/ctgproc/lu.dat').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               'native_lu_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'lu.dat').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
          (root/'p12-independent-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
          print('S2B_NATIVE_P1_P2_ORIGINAL_FIELD_AUDIT='+json.dumps(out))
          PY
      - name: Execute unchanged P3 using BOTH newly native P1 and native P2 files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /tmp/s2b-p3/cteas_p3_makegeo project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp /tmp/s2b-real-p123/lu.dat /tmp/s2b-real-p123/terrel.dat /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p3.csv /tmp/s2b-real-p123/geo.dat
          python native_cpp/reference/compare_p3_makegeo.py --reference project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/makegeo/geo.dat --cpp /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p3.csv --cpp-geo /tmp/s2b-real-p123/geo.dat --report /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p3-original-audit.json || echo 'P3_ORIGINAL_DIFFERENCES_REQUIRE_AUDIT'
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          root=Path('/tmp/s2b-real-p123')
          p12=json.loads((root/'p12-independent-audit.json').read_text())
          p3=json.loads((root/'p3-original-audit.json').read_text())
          summary={'p1_displayed_mismatches':p12['terrain_displayed_mismatches'],
                   'p1_unrounded_max_abs_error':p12['unrounded_terrain_max_abs_error_m'],
                   'p2_displayed_mismatches':p12['landuse_displayed_mismatches'],
                   'p3_failures':p3['failures']}
          print('S2B_FULL_NATIVE_P123_RESULT='+json.dumps(summary))
          if summary['p1_displayed_mismatches'] or summary['p1_unrounded_max_abs_error']>0.0500001:
            raise SystemExit('P1_TERRAIN_OUTSIDE_DECLARED_REFERENCE_GATE')
          if summary['p2_displayed_mismatches'] or summary['p3_failures']:
            raise SystemExit('P2_P3_SCIENCE_REFERENCE_COMPARISON_NOT_PASS')
          print('S2B_FULL_NATIVE_P1_P2_P3=PASS_SCOPED_HEFEI_2022')
          PY
      - name: Archive only small comparison JSON, NEVER SRTM or source binary
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: s2b-full-native-p123-audit-json-only
          path: |
            /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p12-independent-audit.json
            /tmp/s2b-real-p123/p3-original-audit.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

name: S2B recaptured original versus fully native P1 P2 P3 selected scope
on:
  push:
    branches: [automation/verify-s2b-original-recapture-20261017]
    paths: [.github/workflows/s2b-recapture-original-20261017.yml]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  same-source-original-vs-native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 50
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Pin CTEAS-next scientific source exact SHA
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "b7245363108ee280f32decd0fde00e49f0b67da1"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/s2b-recapture-original-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach "b7245363108ee280f32decd0fde00e49f0b67da1"
          echo "S2B_RECAPTURE_NATIVE_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Python source-capture prerequisites
        run: python -m pip install pyyaml==6.0.3
      - name: Install source-preserving Fortran and C++ verification toolchains
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gfortran-11 libgdal-dev
          gfortran --version | head -1
      - name: Restore pinned untouched original vendor source in disposable workdir
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse --no-checkout --depth=1 https://github.com/RRain001/CTEAS.git /tmp/cteas-original-repo
          git -C /tmp/cteas-original-repo fetch --depth=1 origin "dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13"
          git -C /tmp/cteas-original-repo checkout --detach "dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13"
          git -C /tmp/cteas-original-repo sparse-checkout set engine/vendor/src/TERREL_v7.0.0_L141010 engine/vendor/src/CTGPROC_v7.0.0_L150211 engine/vendor/src/MAKEGEO_V3.2_L110401 engine/vendor/src/grid
          test "$(git -C /tmp/cteas-original-repo rev-parse HEAD)" = "dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13"
          mkdir -p engine/vendor/src calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm
          for part in TERREL_v7.0.0_L141010 CTGPROC_v7.0.0_L150211 MAKEGEO_V3.2_L110401 grid; do
            test ! -e "engine/vendor/src/$part"
            ln -s "/tmp/cteas-original-repo/engine/vendor/src/$part" "engine/vendor/src/$part"
          done
          echo '8c4fb11db36d4b976b54f470b7a06ce4e38ab09e934951b0e2c613bddc34e347  engine/vendor/src/MAKEGEO_V3.2_L110401/makegeo.for' | sha256sum --check
          echo 'S2B_ORIGINAL_FORTRAN_SOURCE=PINNED_EPHEMERAL_NO_DISTRIBUTION'
      - name: Fetch frozen SRTM input in ephemeral runner only
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          base=calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 --output "$base/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.tif" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RRain001/CTEAS/dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13/calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.tif
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 --output "$base/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.bbox" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RRain001/CTEAS/dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13/calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.bbox
          echo 'c4211914fce527d2ad41ecac1e668d7faa2904bbbfd9135868ee83ef0d32123f  calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.tif' | sha256sum -c -
          echo 'bd937d99fb13b49ac6185c080359bef050afe76fc63945ac53b7d676547d43dc  calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt' | sha256sum -c -
      - name: Freshly execute untouched original P1 TERREL and P2 CTGPROC
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python native_cpp/reference/capture_p1_p2.py --output /tmp/s2b-original-p123
          echo 'S2B_ORIGINAL_P1_P2_FRESH_RUN=COMPLETE'
      - name: Freshly execute untouched original P3 MAKEGEO
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python native_cpp/reference/capture_p3_makegeo.py --output /tmp/s2b-original-p123
          echo 'S2B_ORIGINAL_P3_FRESH_RUN=COMPLETE'
      - name: Compile unchanged native P1 P2 P3 and strict input adapter
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake -S native_cpp/p1 -B /tmp/s2b-p1 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/s2b-p1 --target cteas_p1_terrain --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp -B /tmp/s2b-p2 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/s2b-p2 --target cteas_p2_gen_fraction --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp/p3 -B /tmp/s2b-p3 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/s2b-p3 --parallel 2
          ctest --test-dir /tmp/s2b-p3 --output-on-failure
          mkdir -p /tmp/s2b-native-p123
      - name: Compute native P1 P2 P3 from same identical source and control inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tif=calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/china_srtm/srtm_60_06_hefei_5km.tif
          gen=calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt
          /tmp/s2b-p1/cteas_p1_terrain "$tif" 510.8846439571007 3531.2689269678035 /tmp/s2b-native-p123/p1.csv
          /tmp/s2b-p2/cteas_p2_gen_fraction "$gen" 510.8846439571007 3531.2689269678035 /tmp/s2b-native-p123/p2.csv
          /tmp/s2b-p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat terrain /tmp/s2b-native-p123/p1.csv /tmp/s2b-native-p123/terrel.dat
          /tmp/s2b-p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat landuse /tmp/s2b-native-p123/p2.csv /tmp/s2b-native-p123/lu.dat
          /tmp/s2b-p3/cteas_p3_makegeo /tmp/s2b-original-p123/p3/makegeo.inp /tmp/s2b-native-p123/lu.dat /tmp/s2b-native-p123/terrel.dat /tmp/s2b-native-p123/p3.csv /tmp/s2b-native-p123/geo.dat
      - name: Independently audit original-vs-native P1 P2 P3 science, no tolerance changes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/s2b-audit
          python native_cpp/reference/compare_p1_terrain.py --reference-dir /tmp/s2b-original-p123 --cpp /tmp/s2b-native-p123/p1.csv --report /tmp/s2b-audit/p1-science.json
          python native_cpp/reference/compare_p2_gen.py --reference /tmp/s2b-original-p123 --cpp /tmp/s2b-native-p123/p2.csv --report /tmp/s2b-audit/p2-science.json
          python native_cpp/reference/compare_p3_makegeo.py --reference /tmp/s2b-original-p123/p3/geo.dat --cpp /tmp/s2b-native-p123/p3.csv --cpp-geo /tmp/s2b-native-p123/geo.dat --report /tmp/s2b-audit/p3-science.json
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json,hashlib
          origin=Path('/tmp/s2b-original-p123'); native=Path('/tmp/s2b-native-p123')
          def values(p,skip):return [float(v) for line in p.read_text().splitlines()[skip:] for v in line.split()]
          a=values(origin/'p1/terrel.dat',10);b=values(native/'terrel.dat',10)
          if len(a)!=2500 or len(b)!=2500:raise SystemExit('TERREL grid shape mismatch')
          terra=sum(x!=y for x,y in zip(a,b))
          luorig=(origin/'p2/lu.dat').read_text().splitlines()
          lunat=(native/'lu.dat').read_text().splitlines()
          if len(luorig)!=2511 or len(lunat)!=2511:raise SystemExit('LU row shape mismatch')
          luerrors=sum(sum(float(x)!=float(y) for x,y in zip(u.split()[2:-1],v.split()[2:-1])) for u,v in zip(luorig[11:],lunat[11:]))
          p1=json.loads(Path('/tmp/s2b-audit/p1-science.json').read_text())
          p2=json.loads(Path('/tmp/s2b-audit/p2-science.json').read_text())
          p3=json.loads(Path('/tmp/s2b-audit/p3-science.json').read_text())
          result={'source_cpp_sha':'b7245363108ee280f32decd0fde00e49f0b67da1',
                  'source_original_sha':'dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13',
                  'same_source_srtm_sha':'c4211914fce527d2ad41ecac1e668d7faa2904bbbfd9135868ee83ef0d32123f',
                  'original_terrel_sha':hashlib.sha256((origin/'p1/terrel.dat').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  'p1_scoped_status':p1['status'],'p2_fraction_gate':p2['numeric_fraction_gate'],
                  'p2_count_gate':p2['internal_count_gate'],'p3_scoped_status':p3['status'],
                  'terrain_displayed_mismatches':terra,'landuse_displayed_mismatches':luerrors,
                  'p3_field_failures':p3['failures'],'p3_field_count':20000}
          Path('/tmp/s2b-audit/summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
          print('S2B_ORIGINAL_NATIVE_FRESH_RECAPTURE='+json.dumps(result))
          if terra or luerrors or p3['failures']:raise SystemExit('S2B_DISPLAYED_SCIENCE_COMPARISON_NOT_EXACT')
          print('S2B_NATIVE_P1_P2_P3_SAME_SOURCE=PASS_SCOPED')
          PY
      - name: Preserve only audit JSON, never vendor source or TIF
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: s2b-original-recapture-metrics-only
          path: /tmp/s2b-audit/*.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

name: S2B native P1-P2 to P3 file-format bridge (exact-source)
on:
  push:
    branches: [automation/verify-s2b-p12-p3-20261017]
    paths: [.github/workflows/s2b-bridge-verify-20261017.yml]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  native-format-and-p3:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 18
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify exact source, no hidden workflow side effects
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "2a075fffc3da2f3142cf1d5f1bf48e466ce17dc4"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/s2b-bridge-verify-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach "2a075fffc3da2f3142cf1d5f1bf48e466ce17dc4"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "2a075fffc3da2f3142cf1d5f1bf48e466ce17dc4"
          echo "S2B_TESTED_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: C++20 compile, independent original-format bridge and untouched P3
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake -S native_cpp/p3 -B /tmp/cteas-s2b-p3 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/cteas-s2b-p3 --parallel 2
          ctest --test-dir /tmp/cteas-s2b-p3 -R '^cteas_p12_p3_scoped_file_contract$' --output-on-failure
          echo 'S2B_P12_P3_FORMAT_HANDOFF=PASS_SOFTWARE'

name: S2B scoped native-format bridge retest at exact PR source
on:
  push:
    branches: [automation/verify-s2b-p12-p3-retest-20261017]
    paths: [.github/workflows/s2b-bridge-verify-retest-20261017.yml]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  native-p3-inputs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 18
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check exact source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "b8d212f4452243a37fe3ea28703bc90eaeae01cd"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/s2b-bridge-verify-retest-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach "b8d212f4452243a37fe3ea28703bc90eaeae01cd"
          echo "S2B_TESTED_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Compile C++20 format adapter and run original-comparison CTest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake -S native_cpp/p3 -B /tmp/cteas-s2b-p3 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/cteas-s2b-p3 --parallel 2
          ctest --test-dir /tmp/cteas-s2b-p3 -R '^cteas_p12_p3_scoped_file_contract$' --output-on-failure
          echo 'S2B_P12_P3_FORMAT_HANDOFF=PASS_SOFTWARE'

name: S2B real native P2 same-input frozen LU and P3 check
on:
  push:
    branches: [automation/verify-s2b-real-native-p2-20261017]
    paths: [.github/workflows/s2b-real-p2-science-probe-20261017.yml]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  real-native-p2:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify pinned source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "b7245363108ee280f32decd0fde00e49f0b67da1"
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/s2b-real-p2-science-probe-20261017.yml"
          git checkout --detach "b7245363108ee280f32decd0fde00e49f0b67da1"
          echo "S2B_P2_NATIVE_SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Build and run actual native P2 against tracked GEN
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgdal-dev
          cmake -S native_cpp -B /tmp/s2b-native-p2 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/s2b-native-p2 --target cteas_p2_gen_fraction --parallel 2
          cmake -S native_cpp/p3 -B /tmp/s2b-native-p3 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build /tmp/s2b-native-p3 --parallel 2
          mkdir -p /tmp/s2b-real
          /tmp/s2b-native-p2/cteas_p2_gen_fraction calpuff_terrain_and_landuse_data_crop/hefei_5km/eurasia_asia_landuse/eausgs2_0la_hefei_5km.generic.txt 510.8846439571007 3531.2689269678035 /tmp/s2b-real/p2-native.csv
          /tmp/s2b-native-p3/cteas_p12_to_p3_dat landuse /tmp/s2b-real/p2-native.csv /tmp/s2b-real/lu.dat
      - name: Independently compare actual P2 fractions with original frozen LU
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json, hashlib
          original=Path('project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/ctgproc/lu.dat')
          written=Path('/tmp/s2b-real/lu.dat')
          orig=original.read_text().splitlines()
          new=written.read_text().splitlines()
          if len(orig)!=2511 or len(new)!=2511:
            raise SystemExit(f'bad LU line counts: {len(orig)}, {len(new)}')
          errors=[]
          for n,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(orig[11:],new[11:])):
            u,v=a.split(),b.split()
            if len(u)!=41 or len(v)!=41 or u[:2]!=v[:2] or u[-1]!=v[-1]:
              raise SystemExit(f'bad LU grid/record on cell {n}')
            for k,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(u[2:-1],v[2:-1])):
              if float(x)!=float(y) and len(errors)<50:
                errors.append([n%50+1,n//50+1,k,float(x),float(y)])
          bad_count=0
          for a,b in zip(orig[11:],new[11:]):
            bad_count+=sum(float(x)!=float(y) for x,y in zip(a.split()[2:-1],b.split()[2:-1]))
          result={'source':'actual C++ P2 computed from repository-tracked GEN data',
                  'cell_count':2500,'fraction_fields':95000,'different_displayed_fraction_fields':bad_count,
                  'first_50_differences':errors,
                  'reference_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  'native_lu_sha256':hashlib.sha256(written.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  'status':'PASS_EXACT_DISPLAYED_LU' if bad_count==0 else 'DIFFERENCES_REQUIRE_AUDIT'}
          Path('/tmp/s2b-real/p2-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
          print('S2B_REAL_NATIVE_P2_LU_COMPARISON='+json.dumps(result))
          PY
      - name: Run unchanged native P3 with actual native P2 and frozen original P1
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /tmp/s2b-native-p3/cteas_p3_makegeo project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp /tmp/s2b-real/lu.dat project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/terrel/terrel.dat /tmp/s2b-real/p3.csv /tmp/s2b-real/geo.dat
          python native_cpp/reference/compare_p3_makegeo.py --reference project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/makegeo/geo.dat --cpp /tmp/s2b-real/p3.csv --cpp-geo /tmp/s2b-real/geo.dat --report /tmp/s2b-real/p3-original-comparison.json || echo 'S2B_P3_SCIENCE_DIFFERENCES_FOUND'
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          root=Path('/tmp/s2b-real')
          p2=json.loads((root/'p2-comparison.json').read_text())
          p3=json.loads((root/'p3-original-comparison.json').read_text())
          print('S2B_NATIVE_P2_HYBRID_P3_RESULT='+json.dumps({'p2_differences':p2['different_displayed_fraction_fields'],'p3_failures':p3['failures']}))
          if p2['different_displayed_fraction_fields']!=0 or p3['failures']!=0:
             raise SystemExit('S2B_SCOPE_NOT_SCIENTIFICALLY_ACCEPTED: inspect first mismatches')
          print('S2B_NATIVE_P2_TO_P3_USING_FROZEN_ORIGINAL_P1=PASS_SCOPED')
          PY
      - name: Preserve numerical provenance and differences
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: s2b-real-native-p2-scientific-audit
          path: |
            /tmp/s2b-real/p2-comparison.json
            /tmp/s2b-real/p3-original-comparison.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
